description:
Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPS and Loss Ratio (%) for different configurations of SepLLM and a Vanilla model. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPS” and is a linear scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at intervals of 1e7. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” and is a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The line representing “Vanilla” is purple with triangle markers and begins at approximately 99.1 at 1e7 TFLOPS, reaching a peak of 99.8 at 3e7 TFLOPS, then declining to 99.2 at 9e8 TFLOPS. The line representing “SepLLM (n=64)” is orange with circle markers, starting at 97.2 at 1e7 TFLOPS and increasing to 99.7 at 3e7 TFLOPS, then decreasing to 99.3 at 9e8 TFLOPS. The line representing “SepLLM (n=128)” is blue with cross markers, beginning at 98.4 at 1e7 TFLOPS, rising to 99.8 at 3e7 TFLOPS, and ending at 99.2 at 9e8 TFLOPS. The line representing “SepLLM (n=64, H)” is green with diamond markers, starting at 98.8 at 1e7 TFLOPS, increasing to 99.8 at 3e7 TFLOPS, and ending at 99.2 at 9e8 TFLOPS. Finally, the line representing “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” is red with star markers, beginning at 94.1 at 1e7 TFLOPS, increasing to 99.6 at 3e7 TFLOPS, and decreasing to 98.8 at 9e8 TFLOPS.
